parsed.name: 珀金埃尔默面阵探测器
parsed.description: 一种用于实验室二维成像测量的面阵探测器，常见于X射线成像、散射或衍射实验中，用于采集连续图像帧并记录样品的二维信号分布。
parsed.description_en: An area detector for laboratory 2D imaging measurements, commonly used in X-ray imaging, scattering, or diffraction experiments to acquire image frames and record the two-dimensional signal distribution from a sample.

actions.description: 查询探测器状态与相机参数。
actions.description_en: Query detector status and camera parameters.
